label: ALD
aesthetic: Queens-prep streetwear: rugby/hoodie/varsity, relaxed jeans or cords, New Balance or suede runners.
signature_pieces: rugby shirt, oversized OCBD, varsity/collegiate knit
New Balance 990-family / suede runner (Derby Hiker in FW25)
chore, trucker, flight/field jacket, toggle coat, puffer vest

hard.why: ALD sits on sneakers (boot only as a soft exception).

min_signals.why: at least 3 of: street top, ALD bottom, dad/suede sneaker, ALD outer

banned.why: No loafers, mules or luxury fashion sneakers.
Boots are RRL/Sweet Stable territory; allowed but ranked low.
No structured tailoring or Italian suede.
Resort, polo and country tops belong to other houses.
No light dress trousers or fashion-distressed denim.

pairing_rules.why: Grey trousers are only ALD with a street top (high/low).
Denim on denim needs clearly different washes.

weekday.modifier: Casual weekday only (street top + grey trouser + NB).

card_note: Queens prep: varsity or hoodie, relaxed jeans, New Balance or suede runners.
gap_note: No rugby, no oversized OCBD, no grey 990: using the NB leather and suede sneakers.

must_differ.polo: Always sneakers, never loafers; the top is street/collegiate, not OCBD/polo.
must_differ.rrl: Sneaker instead of boot; no work-shirt + boot stack.

scoring.empty_state: If 0 looks pass, show the closest look failing only ALD-R2 (2 of 4 signals) + the gap note.
